$Comment: Hold behavior wrapper that delegates ambient posture/flavor/sleep logic to the shared ambient component.

HoldBaseAnimation.Description: Animation to persist while in Hold when no transient flavor animation is running.

SleepDelayAfterHoldEnterRange.Description: Minimum delay before Hold can transition to sleep after entering Hold.

SleepDelayAfterLastSleepRange.Description: Minimum delay before Hold can transition to sleep after waking from sleep.

HoldStillWeight.Description: Random weight for simply staying in the hold posture without playing a flavor animation.

HoldStillDurationRange.Description: How long to stay in the hold posture when the hold-still branch is selected.

DayFlavorAnimation.Description: A flavor animation to play during the day. Ignored if null or empty.

DayFlavorAnimationAfter.Description: Optional animation to play after the daytime flavor animation.

DayFlavorAnimationLength.Description: How long to play the daytime flavor animation.

DayTimePeriod.Description: The hour range considered to be daytime for this NPC.

NightFlavorAnimation.Description: A flavor animation to play at night. Ignored if null or empty.

NightFlavorAnimationAfter.Description: Optional animation to play after the night flavor animation.

NightFlavorAnimationLength.Description: How long to play the night flavor animation.

AlwaysSleepAtNight.Description: Whether this NPC always sleeps through the whole night.

SleepEnabled.Description: Whether hold ambient behavior can transition into sleep.

DayTimeNapWeight.Description: Weight used to determine if the NPC should have a short nap during the day. Set to 0 to disable.

CanHear.Description: Whether to consider nearby NPCs that would wake this NPC.

HearingRange.Description: Range used to detect nearby NPCs that would wake this NPC.

ReactToNPCs.Description: Whether to consider nearby NPCs when deciding to sleep.

Attitudes.Description: Attitudes that would wake this NPC.

Content.$Comment: Hold State: release target, initialize sleep gates, and run shared ambient idle behavior.

Instructions.$Comment: Clear combat target when entering Hold.
Refresh hold-entry sleep delay and resume any pending post-sleep cooldown.
Apply hold posture on Hold entry.
